newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NED ELEVATOR TO ROUND OFF HES SALE SOON.
newsitem.headline: NED ELEVATOR TO ROUND OFF HES SALE SOON.

text.p: Investment company NV Nederlandsche Elevator Beleggingsmaatschappij (NEBM) said on Wednesday it expected shortly to round off the sale of its stake in HES Beheer , parent of Rotterdam-based grain transhipment company European Bulk Services.
"NEBM expects to complete the sale of its entire holding in H.E.S Beheer shortly," the company said in a statement.
It added that at the same time it would give up its status as a fiscal investment institution effective January 1, 1997.
These measures, taken together with a number of amendments to its articles of association yet to be approved by shareholders, should enhance NEBM's chances of finding a buyer, the company said.
"The managing board believes...that the sale could raise some 2,400 guilders per share and 940 guilders per founding certificate," it added.
NEBM shares closed trading on Tuesday at 1,675 guilders.
